name: Auto Eater
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: nicolas-reig
description: This is a simple client mod to stop worrying about eating all the time, that selects the food and eats it. It detects whenever the foodbar falls a certain threshold, selects food in your hotbar, and starts eating it.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3)
evidence: Not run: Java did not start.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
